metas.name: Captain America
metas.description: Superhero Captain America battles the evil forces of the archvillain called The Scarab, who poisons his enemies and steals a secret device capable of destroying buildings by sound vibrations.

metas.name: The Incredible Hulk
metas.description: An accidental overdose of gamma radiation causes a mutation in scientist David Banner's DNA: now whenever he becomes angry, he metamorphoses into a seven-foot-tall, 330-pound, mindless muscular green creature.

metas.name: The Return of the Incredible Hulk
metas.description: Continuing his solitary flight, David Banner arrives in a small town where he saves the life of a young heiress, the target of a deadly conspiracy orchestrated by her stepmother and a corrupt physician. While working undercover to protect the girl and dismantle the plot, Banner must struggle to contain the beast within, especially when the arrival of reporter Jack McGee threatens to expose his secret to the world.

metas.name: Dr. Strange
metas.description: A psychiatrist becomes the new Sorcerer Supreme of the Earth in order to battle an evil Sorceress from the past.

metas.name: Spider-Man Strikes Back
metas.description: At the New York State University, one of Peter Parker's tutors has accidentally given three students all the materials they need to create an atomic bomb. While Peter Parker tries to find out what's happened, the police suspect him of the crime, and Peter has to deal with an attractive journalist determined to get an interview with Spider-Man. Then dastardly millionaire Mr. White shows up, and will stop at nothing to get his hands on the atomic bomb. Spider-Man must defeat this scheming villain and stop him blowing up the World Trade Centre.

metas.name: Captain America
metas.description: A recipient of an experimental body enhancement chemical retaliates against his would be killers as a star spangled superhero.

metas.name: Captain America II: Death Too Soon
metas.description: The star spangled hero must battle a villain's plan to poison America with a chemical that horrifically accelerates the aging process.

metas.name: Spider-Man: The Dragon's Challenge
metas.description: Spider-Man goes to China to help an official accused of World War II treachery.  Two episodes of the TV series "Spider Man" edited together and released as a feature.

metas.name: Bride of the Incredible Hulk
metas.description: David Banner enlists the aid of Dr. Carolyn Fields, a psychiatrist who he believes will be able to help him, through hypnosis, to control his transformations into the Hulk. As the two work closely together, they begin to form a bond.

metas.name: Red Sonja
metas.description: The fearless warrior Red Sonja sets out to avenge her family's murder and rid her kingdom from the tyrannical rule of evil Queen Gedren.

metas.name: Howard the Duck
metas.description: A sarcastic humanoid duck is pulled from his homeworld to Earth where he must stop an alien invasion with the help of a nerdy scientist and a struggling female rock singer.

metas.name: The Incredible Hulk Returns
metas.description: Hopefully on the verge of curing his Hulk condition, Banner meets his colleague, Don Blake, who is mystically linked to a Viking warrior, Thor.

metas.name: The Trial of the Incredible Hulk
metas.description: When Banner is held as a witness to a violent crime linked to the Kingpin, the fugitive is helped by lawyer Matt Murdock who is also the superhero, Daredevil.

metas.name: The Punisher
metas.description: When Frank Castle's family is murdered by criminals, he wages war on crime as a vigilante assassin known only as The Punisher.

metas.name: The Death of the Incredible Hulk
metas.description: When Scientist Dr. Ronold Pratt and his wife are kidnapped, David Banner must become The Incredible Hulk for one last time

metas.name: Captain America
metas.description: Frozen in the ice for decades, Captain America is freed to battle against archcriminal The Red Skull.

metas.name: Firearm
metas.description: Private investigator Alec Swan, against his own wishes, becomes embroiled in a case involving the strange and the ultra-human. The first movie that's faithful to the comic book... because it IS the comic book!  This VHS film was bundled with Malibu Comics' Firearm #0, part of its Ultraverse line.

metas.name: Generation X
metas.description: The new teenage students at a school for mutants (normal-looking humans with fantastic powers) try to stop an evil scientist from controlling the world's dreams.

metas.name: Men in Black
metas.description: James, an NYC cop, is hired by Agent K of a secret government agency that monitors extraterrestrial life on Earth. Together, they must recover an item that has been stolen by an intergalactic villain.

metas.name: Nick Fury: Agent of S.H.I.E.L.D.
metas.description: Agent Nick Fury is asked to fight the menace of Hydra after exiling himself in the Yukon since the end of the Cold War.

metas.name: Blade
metas.description: A half-vampire, half-mortal man becomes a protector of the mortal race, while slaying evil vampires.

metas.name: X-Men
metas.description: In a world where mutants (evolved super-powered humans) exist and are discriminated against, two groups form for an inevitable clash: the supremacist Brotherhood, and the pacifist X-Men.

metas.name: Blade II
metas.description: Blade forms an uneasy alliance with the vampire council in order to combat the Reapers, who are feeding on vampires.

metas.name: Spider-Man
metas.description: A shy teenager is bitten by a genetically modified spider and uses his new spider-like abilities to fight injustice as a masked superhero.

metas.name: Men in Black II
metas.description: Agent J is sent to find Agent K and restore his memory after the re-appearance of a case from K's past.

metas.name: Daredevil
metas.description: A man blinded by toxic waste which also enhanced his remaining senses fights crime as an acrobatic martial arts superhero.

metas.name: X2: X-Men United
metas.description: When anti-mutant Colonel William Stryker kidnaps Professor X and attacks his school, the X-Men must ally with their archenemy Magneto to stop him.

metas.name: Hulk
metas.description: Bruce Banner, a genetics researcher with a tragic past, suffers a lab accident that makes him transform into a raging, giant green monster when angered, making him a target of forces seeking to abuse his power.

metas.name: The Punisher
metas.description: An undercover FBI agent becomes a vigilante and sets out to unleash his wrath upon the corrupt businessman who slaughtered his entire family at a reunion.

metas.name: Spider-Man 2
metas.description: Peter Parker is beset with troubles in his failing personal life as he battles a former brilliant scientist named Otto Octavius.

metas.name: Blade: Trinity
metas.description: Blade, now a wanted man by the FBI, must join forces with the Nightstalkers to face his most challenging enemy yet: Dracula.

metas.name: Elektra
metas.description: An assassin's change of heart leads her into a war against an evil crime syndicate.

metas.name: Man-Thing
metas.description: Agents of an oil tycoon vanish while exploring a swamp marked for drilling. The local sheriff investigates and faces a Seminole legend come to life: Man-Thing, a shambling swamp-monster whose touch burns those who feel fear.

metas.name: Fantastic Four
metas.description: A group of astronauts gain superpowers after a cosmic radiation exposure and must use them to oppose the plans of their enemy, Doctor Victor Von Doom.

metas.name: X-Men: The Last Stand
metas.description: The human government develops a cure for mutations, and Jean Grey becomes a darker uncontrollable persona called the Phoenix who allies with Magneto, causing escalation into an all-out battle for the X-Men.

metas.name: Ghost Rider
metas.description: A motorcycle stuntman who sold his soul becomes a supernatural agent of vengeance.

metas.name: Spider-Man 3
metas.description: A strange black entity from another world bonds with Peter Parker and causes inner turmoil as he contends with new villains, temptations, and revenge.

metas.name: Fantastic Four: Rise of the Silver Surfer
metas.description: The Fantastic Four learn that they aren't the only super-powered beings in the universe when they square off against the powerful Silver Surfer and the planet-eating Galactus.

metas.name: Iron Man
metas.description: After being held captive in an Afghan cave, billionaire engineer Tony Stark creates a unique weaponized suit of armor to fight evil.

metas.name: The Incredible Hulk
metas.description: Bruce Banner, a scientist on the run from the U.S. Government, must find a cure for the monster he turns into whenever he loses his temper.

metas.name: Punisher: War Zone
metas.description: Frank Castle, known as the Punisher, ruthlessly demolishes organized crime, but it starts an even bigger war.

metas.name: X-Men Origins: Wolverine
metas.description: The early years of James Logan, featuring his rivalry with his brother Victor Creed, his service in the special forces team Weapon X, and his experimentation into the metal-lined mutant Wolverine.

metas.name: Kick-Ass
metas.description: Dave Lizewski is an unnoticed high school student and comic book fan who one day decides to become a superhero, even though he has no powers, training or meaningful reason to do so.

metas.name: Iron Man 2
metas.description: With the world now aware of his identity as Iron Man, Tony Stark must contend with both his declining health and a vengeful mad man with ties to his father's legacy.

metas.name: Thor
metas.description: The powerful but arrogant god Thor is cast out of Asgard to live amongst humans in Midgard (Earth), where he soon becomes one of their finest defenders.

metas.name: X-Men: First Class
metas.description: In the 1960s, superpowered humans Charles Xavier and Erik Lensherr work together to find others like them, but Erik's vengeful pursuit of an ambitious mutant who ruined his life causes a schism to divide them.

metas.name: Captain America: The First Avenger
metas.description: Steve Rogers, a rejected military soldier, transforms into Captain America after taking a dose of a "Super-Soldier serum". But being Captain America comes at a price as he attempts to take down a warmonger and a terrorist organiza...

metas.name: Marvel One-Shot: The Consultant
metas.description: Agents Coulson and Sitwell plan to derail General Thaddeus "Thunderbolt" Ross from interfering with S.H.I.E.L.D. affairs with a very special person.

metas.name: Marvel One-Shot: A Funny Thing Happened on the Way to Thor's Hammer
metas.description: Agent Coulson stops at a convenience store and deals with a coincidental robbery during his visit.

metas.name: Ghost Rider: Spirit of Vengeance
metas.description: Johnny Blaze, tortured by the Ghost Rider's curse, gets a chance of redemption through protecting the Devil's son, whose father is pursuing him.

metas.name: The Avengers
metas.description: Earth's mightiest heroes must come together and learn to fight as a team if they are going to stop the mischievous Loki and his alien army from enslaving humanity.

metas.name: Men in Black 3
metas.description: Agent J travels in time to M.I.B.'s early days in 1969 to stop an alien from assassinating his friend Agent K and changing history.

metas.name: The Amazing Spider-Man
metas.description: After Peter Parker is bitten by a genetically altered spider, he gains newfound, spider-like powers and ventures out to save the city from the machinations of a mysterious reptilian foe.

metas.name: Marvel One-Shot: Item 47
metas.description: SHIELD agent Sitwell is assigned to recover an abandoned Chitauri weapon being used by a young couple robbing a bank

metas.name: Iron Man 3
metas.description: When Tony Stark's world is torn apart by a formidable terrorist called the Mandarin, he starts an odyssey of rebuilding and retribution.

metas.name: The Wolverine
metas.description: Wolverine comes to Japan to meet an old friend whose life he saved years ago, and gets embroiled in a conspiracy involving yakuza and mutants.

metas.name: Kick-Ass 2
metas.description: Following Kick-Ass' heroics, other citizens are inspired to become masked crusaders, but Red Mist leads his own group of evil super-villains to get revenge, kill Kick-Ass, and destroy everything he stands for.

metas.name: Marvel One-Shot: Agent Carter
metas.description: Frustrated at being marginalized at work, Peggy Carter goes on an unauthorized solo field mission.

metas.name: Thor: The Dark World
metas.description: When the Dark Elves attempt to plunge the universe into darkness, Thor must embark on a perilous and personal journey that will reunite him with doctor Jane Foster.

metas.name: Marvel One-Shot: All Hail the King
metas.description: A documentary filmmaker interviews the now-famous Trevor Slattery from behind bars.

metas.name: Marvel Studios: Assembling a Universe
metas.description: A look at the story behind Marvel Studios and the Marvel Cinematic Universe, featuring interviews and behind-the-scenes footage from all of the Marvel films, the Marvel One-Shots and "Marvel's Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D."

metas.name: Captain America: The Winter Soldier
metas.description: As Steve Rogers struggles to embrace his role in the modern world, he teams up with a fellow Avenger and S.H.I.E.L.D agent, Black Widow, to battle a new threat from history: an assassin known as the Winter Soldier.

metas.name: The Amazing Spider-Man 2
metas.description: When New York is put under siege by Oscorp, it is up to Spider-Man to save the city he swore to protect as well as his loved ones.

metas.name: X-Men: Days of Future Past
metas.description: The X-Men send Wolverine to the past in a desperate effort to change history and prevent an event that results in doom for both humans and mutants.

metas.name: Guardians of the Galaxy
metas.description: A group of intergalactic criminals must pull together to stop a fanatical warrior with plans to purge the universe.

metas.name: Marvel 75 Years: From Pulp to Pop!
metas.description: Emily Vancamp hosts this one of a kind experience showing the history and development of Marvel from the first comic book to the latest blockbuster hit.

metas.name: Kingsman: The Secret Service
metas.description: A spy organisation recruits a promising street kid into the agency's training program, while a global threat emerges from a twisted tech genius.

metas.name: Avengers: Age of Ultron
metas.description: When Tony Stark and Bruce Banner try to jump-start a dormant peacekeeping program called Ultron, things go horribly wrong and it's up to Earth's mightiest heroes to stop the villainous Ultron from enacting his terrible plan.

metas.name: Ant-Man
metas.description: Armed with a super-suit with the astonishing ability to shrink in scale but increase in strength, cat burglar Scott Lang must embrace his inner hero and help his mentor, Dr. Hank Pym, pull off a plan that will save the world.

metas.name: Fantastic Four
metas.description: Four young outsiders teleport to an alternate and dangerous universe which alters their physical form in shocking ways. The four must learn to harness their new abilities and work together to save Earth from a former friend turned...

metas.name: Captain America: 75 Heroic Years
metas.description: Marvel celebrates the history of Captain America, both in the comics and on TV and film, and examines the character as a reflection of American culture throughout the years.

metas.name: Deadpool
metas.description: A wisecracking mercenary gets experimented on and becomes immortal yet hideously scarred, and sets out to track down the man who ruined his looks.

metas.name: Captain America: Civil War
metas.description: Political involvement in the Avengers' affairs causes a rift between Captain America and Iron Man.

metas.name: X-Men: Apocalypse
metas.description: In the 1980s, the X-Men must defeat an ancient all-powerful mutant, En Sabah Nur, who intends to thrive by bringing destruction to the world.

metas.name: Marvel One-Shot: Team Thor
metas.description: The story of what the hammer-wielding Nordic god Thor was up to while the rest of the Avengers were battling each other in "Captain America: Civil War". He moves into a flat with office worker Darryl Jacobson in Australia.

metas.name: Doctor Strange
metas.description: While on a journey of physical and spiritual healing, a brilliant neurosurgeon is drawn into the world of the mystic arts.

metas.name: Marvel One-Shot: Team Thor: Part 2
metas.description: Thor enjoys some time away from battle.

metas.name: Logan
metas.description: In a future where mutants are nearly extinct, an elderly and weary Logan leads a quiet life. But when Laura, a mutant child pursued by scientists, comes to him for help, he must get her to safety.

metas.name: Deadpool: No Good Deed
metas.description: Deadpool sees an opportunity to save the day, but it doesn't go entirely as planned.

metas.name: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 2
metas.description: The Guardians struggle to keep together as a team while dealing with their personal family issues, notably Star-Lord's encounter with his father, the ambitious celestial being Ego.

metas.name: Spider-Man: Homecoming
metas.description: Peter Parker tries to stop Adrian 'The Vulture' Toomes from selling weapons made with advanced Chitauri technology while trying to balance his life as an ordinary high school student.

metas.name: Kingsman: The Golden Circle
metas.description: After the Kingsman's headquarters is destroyed and the world is held hostage, an allied spy organization in the United States is discovered. These two elite secret agencies must band together to defeat a common enemy.

metas.name: Thor: Ragnarok
metas.description: Imprisoned on the planet Sakaar, Thor must race against time to return to Asgard and stop Ragnarök, the destruction of his world, at the hands of the powerful and ruthless villain Hela.

metas.name: Black Panther
metas.description: T'Challa, heir to the hidden but advanced kingdom of Wakanda, must step forward to lead his people into a new future and must confront a challenger from his country's past.

metas.name: Marvel One-Shot: Team Darryl
metas.description: With Thor gone, Darryl searches for a new roommate, but only the Grandmaster responds to his ad.

metas.name: Avengers: Infinity War
metas.description: The Avengers and their allies must be willing to sacrifice all in an attempt to defeat the powerful Thanos before his blitz of devastation and ruin puts an end to the universe.

metas.name: Deadpool 2
metas.description: Foul-mouthed mutant mercenary Wade Wilson (a.k.a. Deadpool) assembles a team of fellow mutant rogues to protect a young boy with abilities from the brutal, time-traveling cyborg Cable.

metas.name: Ant-Man and the Wasp
metas.description: As Scott Lang balances being both a superhero and a father, Hope van Dyne and Dr. Hank Pym present an urgent new mission that finds the Ant-Man fighting alongside The Wasp to uncover secrets from their past.

metas.name: Venom
metas.description: A failed reporter is bonded to an alien entity, one of many symbiotes who have invaded Earth. But the being takes a liking to Earth and decides to protect it.

metas.name: Once Upon a Deadpool
metas.description: A kidnapped Fred Savage is forced to endure Deadpool's PG-13 rendition of Deadpool 2 as a Princess Bride-esque story that's full of magic, wonder and a single F.

metas.name: Captain Marvel
metas.description: Carol Danvers becomes one of the universe's most powerful heroes when Earth is caught in the middle of a galactic war between two alien races.

metas.name: Avengers: Endgame
metas.description: After the devastating events of Avengers: Infinity War (2018), the universe is in ruins. With the help of remaining allies, the Avengers assemble once more in order to reverse Thanos' actions and restore balance to the universe.

metas.name: Dark Phoenix
metas.description: Jean Grey begins to develop incredible powers that corrupt and turn her into a Dark Phoenix, causing the X-Men to have to decide if her life is worth more than all of humanity.

metas.name: Men in Black: International
metas.description: The MIB tackle a mole in their organization.

metas.name: Spider-Man: Far From Home
metas.description: Peter Parker heads to Europe hoping for a normal summer, but elemental attacks and a mysterious new hero pull him back into a dangerous fight he isn't ready to embrace.

metas.name: Marvel One-Shot: Peter's To-Do List
metas.description: On the eve of his departure to Europe, Peter Parker tells Ned Leeds that he has several things to do before they leave.

metas.name: Marvel Studios: Expanding the Universe
metas.description: An exciting look into the future of Marvel Studios' films and upcoming Disney+ series.

metas.name: The New Mutants
metas.description: Five young mutants, just discovering their abilities while held in a secret facility against their will, fight to escape their past sins and save themselves.

metas.name: Marvel's Behind the Mask
metas.description: Meet the writers and artists behind characters like Black Panther, Miles Morales, Ms. Marvel, Luke Cage, the X-Men, Captain Marvel, and many other characters in the Marvel Universe, highlighting their impact on pop culture and media.

metas.name: Black Widow
metas.description: Natasha Romanoff confronts the darker parts of her ledger when a dangerous conspiracy with ties to her past arises.

metas.name: Shang-Chi and the Legend of the Ten Rings
metas.description: Shang-Chi, the master of weaponry-based Kung Fu, is forced to confront his past after being drawn into the Ten Rings organization.

metas.name: Venom: Let There Be Carnage
metas.description: Eddie Brock attempts to reignite his career by interviewing serial killer Cletus Kasady, who becomes the host of the symbiote Carnage and escapes prison after a failed execution.

metas.name: Eternals
metas.description: The saga of the Eternals, a race of immortal beings who lived on Earth and shaped its history and civilizations.

metas.name: Spider-Man: No Way Home
metas.description: Peter Parker turns to Doctor Strange after his identity destroys the life he knows, but a magical mistake draws powerful outsiders into his world and forces him to confront what being Spider Man really means.

metas.name: The King's Man
metas.description: In the early years of the 20th century, the Kingsman agency is formed to stand against a cabal plotting a war to wipe out millions of people.

metas.name: Morbius
metas.description: Biochemist Michael Morbius tries to cure himself of a rare blood disease, but he inadvertently infects himself with a form of vampirism instead.

metas.name: Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness
metas.description: Doctor Strange teams up with a mysterious teenage girl who can travel across multiverses, to battle other-universe versions of himself which threaten to wipe out the multiverse. They seek help from the Scarlet Witch, Wong and others.

metas.name: Thor: Love and Thunder
metas.description: Thor enlists the help of Valkyrie, Korg and ex-girlfriend Jane Foster to fight Gorr the God Butcher, who intends to make the gods extinct.

metas.name: Werewolf by Night
metas.description: Follows a lycanthrope superhero who fights evil using the abilities given to him by a curse brought on by his bloodline.

metas.name: Black Panther: Wakanda Forever
metas.description: The people of Wakanda fight to protect their home from intervening world powers as they mourn the death of King T'Challa.

metas.name: The Guardians of the Galaxy Holiday Special
metas.description: Star-Lord, Drax, Rocket, Mantis, and Groot engage in some spirited shenanigans in an all-new original special created for Disney+.

metas.name: Ant-Man and the Wasp: Quantumania
metas.description: Scott Lang and Hope Van Dyne are dragged into the Quantum Realm, along with Hope's parents and Scott's daughter Cassie. Together they must find a way to escape, but what secrets is Hope's mother hiding? And who is the mysterious K...

metas.name: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3
metas.description: Still reeling from the loss of Gamora, Peter Quill rallies his team to defend the universe and one of their own - a mission that could mean the end of the Guardians if not successful.

metas.name: Stan Lee
metas.description: 100 years of dreaming. 100 years of creating. 100 years of Stan Lee.

metas.name: The Marvels
metas.description: Carol Danvers gets her powers entangled with those of Kamala Khan and Monica Rambeau, forcing them to work together to save the universe.

metas.name: Madame Web
metas.description: Forced to confront her past, Cassandra Webb, a Manhattan paramedic that may have clairvoyant abilities, forms a relationship with three young women destined for powerful futures, if they can survive their threatening present.

metas.name: Deadpool & Wolverine
metas.description: Deadpool is offered a place in the Marvel Cinematic Universe by the Time Variance Authority, but instead recruits a variant of Wolverine to save his universe from extinction.

metas.name: Venom: The Last Dance
metas.description: Eddie Brock and Venom must make a devastating decision as they're pursued by a mysterious military man and alien monsters from Venom's home world.

metas.name: Kraven the Hunter
metas.description: Kraven's complex relationship with his ruthless father, Nikolai Kravinoff, starts him down a path of vengeance with brutal consequences, motivating him to become not only the greatest hunter in the world, but also one of its most ...

metas.name: Captain America: Brave New World
metas.description: Sam Wilson, the new Captain America, finds himself in the middle of an international incident and must discover the motive behind a nefarious global plan.

metas.name: Thunderbolts*
metas.description: After finding themselves ensnared in a death trap, an unconventional team of antiheroes must go on a dangerous mission that will force them to confront the darkest corners of their pasts.

metas.name: The Fantastic Four: First Steps
metas.description: Forced to balance their roles as heroes with the strength of their family bond, the Fantastic Four must defend Earth from a ravenous space god called Galactus and his enigmatic herald, the Silver Surfer.

metas.name: The Punisher: One Last Kill
metas.description: As Frank Castle searches for meaning beyond revenge, an unexpected force pulls him back into the fight.

metas.name: Spider-Man: Brand New Day
metas.description: A forgotten Peter Parker lives alone as a full-time Spider-Man until mounting pressure triggers a dangerous change and a powerful new enemy emerges.

metas.name: Avengers: Doomsday
metas.description: Plot under wraps.

metas.name: Avengers: Secret Wars
metas.description: Plot Under Wraps

metas.name: Black Panther 3
metas.description: T'Challa's son, T'Challa, comes of age with eyes on the crown of Wakanda.

metas.name: Armor Wars
metas.description: James Rhodes must confront one of Tony Stark's greatest fears when Stark's tech falls into the wrong hands.
